description: With most manufacturers focusing on delivering large displays, capable chipsets, or appreciable cameras in the mid-range segment, design is something that is increasingly being overlooked on. Infinix, however, has never been particularly shy about experimenting with design, as evident by the recently introduced Infinix Note 60 Pro Pininfarina Edition. The new Hot 70 Pro 5G+ is perhaps yet another one of its ambitious attempts.
title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G+ First Impressions

description: Binance has warned cryptocurrency users about a rise in phishing attempts delivered through text messages. The fraudulent alerts impersonate Binance and claim that accounts have experienced suspicious logins or setting changes. Users are being urged to avoid links in such messages, verify suspicious contact details through Binance Verify, and use the official app or website instead.
title: Binance Warns of Phishing Scam Targeting Crypto Users With Fake Account Security Alerts

description: Noise has unveiled the Master Buds Open with Sound by Bose Technology at IFA Berlin 2026. The new earphones will be available in India starting in late September 2026 through leading retail stores, major e-commerce platforms and Noise's official website. The company has not announced the price or detailed specifications of the model.
title: IFA 2026: Noise Master Buds Open With Sound by Bose Technology Unveiled

description: The Stephen Curry Special Edition of the Pixel Watch 5 is now available to buy in the US, nearly two weeks after the standard smartwatch models went on sale. The 45mm edition costs $579.99 (roughly Rs. 54,800) and comes with a Satin Pyrite case and Rye Performance Loop featuring Curry branding. It retains the standard Pixel Watch 5’s Actua 360 AMOLED LTPO display, Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated platform, Gemini features and health tracking. The 45mm model also offers up to 40 hours of battery life.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Stephen Curry Special Edition Goes on Sale: Price, Features and More

description: Swiss Bitcoin service provider Pocket Bitcoin has expanded its disclosure of an August security breach after a forensic review identified two affected customer groups. Transaction information linked to 5,120 clients was exposed, while correspondence involving another 291 customers contained potentially more sensitive records. Pocket Bitcoin said its Bitcoin-holding accounts remained inaccessible to the attacker.
title: Pocket Bitcoin Data Breach Exposes Personal and Financial Information of 5,411 Customers

description: Luna Band is now shipping worldwide. The wearable is listed at Rs. 13,999 on Luna's India website. It costs $149 in the US. It is available in Aloe Green, Desert Beige and Onyx Black colour options. Shoppers can purchase additional straps in Ember Orange, Atlantic Blue and Glacier Blue shades. The Luna Band is advertised to offer up to 10 days of battery life on a single charge.
title: Luna Band Now Available Globally: Check Price in India, Specifications and Features

description: WhatsApp could soon allow users to bring compatible third-party agents into the messaging platform. A new Agents section reportedly lets users configure services, with support for up to five agents and API keys used to establish their connections. Each service would have a separate conversation and access only to messages shared there. However, these chats are not expected to have end-to-end encryption, as messages would be handled through a Meta service for the agent developer. The feature is currently reaching a limited number of Android users.
title: WhatsApp Reportedly Rolling Out Third-Party AI Agent Chats to Android Users

description: Nvidia is expanding its local AI push with new hardware and software announced at IFA 2026. The company’s RTX Spark platform is set to reach Windows PCs in October, while new tools aim to simplify the use of AI agents and speed up local inference. Lenovo and Acer are among the hardware partners, with Lenovo showing two Yoga models built around RTX Spark. Nvidia has also introduced PAIR, which allows computers on the same network to share AI inference workloads.
title: IFA 2026: Nvidia RTX Spark PCs, Local AI Tools Announced With October Launch Planned

description: Lenovo has launched a new range of laptops and PCs at IFA 2026. It announced the new Lenovo IdeaPad Vibe series, Yoga Pro 9n, Yoga 9n 2-in-1, IdeaCentre AIO i and ThinkBook 14 Gen 9. The Lenovo Yoga Pro 9n and Yoga 9n 2-in-1 use Nvidia's RTX Spark platform. They are confirmed to be available later this year.
title: IFA 2026: Lenovo Unveiled New IdeaPad, Yoga and ThinkBook Laptops

description: Microsoft has announced a monthly cap on Xbox Cloud Gaming for Game Pass members. Starting in November, Game Pass Ultimate members will get 15 hours of Xbox Cloud Gaming in a month. Monthly cloud gaming hours for Game Pass Premium and Essential subscribers will be capped at 10 hours and 5 hours, respectively.
title: Microsoft Will Put Monthly Cap on Xbox Cloud Gaming Hours for Game Pass Members in November

description: Xiaomi will introduce its Power Bank 20000mAh 165W in India on September 8. The accessory can deliver 165W of maximum output and split power between two devices at 120W and 45W. It includes a built-in braided USB Type-C cable and a colour display for monitoring charging information. The power bank supports several charging standards and includes temperature management with 12 layers of protection. It has a rated energy of 76Wh and follows Xiaomi's Power Bank 5i 20000mAh 67W.
title: Xiaomi Power Bank 20000mAh 165W India Launch Date Announced; Key Features Teased

description: Tecno Pova 8 Pro 5G Tonino Lamborghini Limited Edition has been launched in global markets with a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Ultimate SoC and a 6,500mAh battery. Tecno has designed the Pova 8 Pro 5G Tonino Lamborghini Limited Edition in collaboration with the Italian lifestyle brand Tonino Lamborghini. It is offered in a Tonino Lamborghini Black shade with a black-and-red palette and a hexagon pattern.
title: Tecno Pova 8 Pro 5G Tonino Lamborghini Limited Edition Unveiled: Specifications, Features

description: TCL announced new smartphones and tablets at IFA 2026 on Thursday. The company has introduced the TCL P80 series, which comprises the TCL P80, TCL P80 Pro, and TCL P80 Ultra. The Ultra model has a a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto camera, while the P80 Pro gets a 1.5K NXTPAPER AMOLED display and a 5,800mAh battery. Meanwhile, the TCL TAB A1 family includes four models with 11-inch and 12.2-inch screen options, offered in both standard and NXTPAPER variants across both screen sizes.
title: TCL P80 Series, Tab A1 Series With NXTPAPER Displays Unveiled at IFA 2026

description: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 Active has been launched in select global markets. Moreover, the Xiaomi Smart Band 11 is now available for pre-order in China. The Active model is offered in Black, Gray, and Pomelo Pink colour options and will go on sale in select global markets via the Xiaomi online store. Meanwhile, the standard model is currently available for pre-order via the Xiaomi China online store in Black, Pink, Purple, and Yellow shades. The Xiaomi Smart Band 11 Active sports a 1.47-inch (172 x 320 pixels) TFT display with 247 ppi pixel density, a reinforced glass cover, and more than 100 watch faces.
title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 Active Launched With Up to 21 Days of Battery Life; Smart Band 11 Price, Features Revealed

description: Oppo Find X10 and Oppo Find X10 Pro Max have been spotted on the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) database in India with the model numbers CPH2911 and CPH2913. The listing also suggests that two flagship smartphones could be launched in India soon, following their anticipated debut in China this month. However, the listing does not reveal the exact launch date, pricing details, or key specifications of the two Oppo Find X10 series handsets. This comes shortly after the key specifications and features of the Oppo Find X10 surfaced online.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10 India Launch Seems Imminent as Phones Appear on Certification Site

description: Dreame Aqua20 Pro Ultra Roller X Complete steam robot vacuum launched at IFA 2026. It offers 40,000Pa suction power. It features a roller mop that can extend outward by up to 8cm to enable 180 degree celcious steam and hot water mopping. The company has also unveiled the Leaptic Cube mini action camera and its wet and dry T series with five models.
title: IFA 2026: Dreame Aqua20 Pro Ultra Roller X Complete Launched, Leaptic Cube Tags Along

description: Lingverse has showcased iKairos, a modular AI device that can switch between a desktop robot and a wearable pendant. The device uses a removable circular core to collect information from different environments, while the company's LifeOS software analyses the data for patterns and connections. Lingverse says iKairos can use details about routines, relationships and experiences to generate contextual suggestions. The system also includes physical privacy controls and local voice processing. Pricing and release details have not been announced yet.
title: IFA 2026: Lingverse iKairos Debuts as a Desktop Robot and Wearable AI Pendant

description: US and UK law enforcement agencies have signed an MoU to jointly investigate scam centres linked to cryptocurrency and cyber-enabled investment fraud. The agreement establishes a framework for intelligence sharing, coordinated investigations and jurisdiction decisions. The first joint disruption exercise, involving private-sector firms, is planned for October in London.
title: US, UK Coordinate Efforts to Tackle Crypto Scams and Investment Fraud

description: Vivo is preparing to introduce its new operating system dubbed OriginOS 7, which will be based on Android 17. The update will be unveiled at the company's annual vivo Developer Conference (VDC) later this month. It is expected to bring a redesigned interface with new materials and liquid-style animations, alongside several underlying performance improvements. As per the company, handsets running OriginOS 7 will deliver improved graphics rendering, app launch times, and power efficiency.
title: Vivo Announces Android 17-Based OriginOS 7 Launch Date; to Bring Liquid Glass-Like UI, Performance Upgrades

description: Oppo A7 Pro will be launched in China on September 11 at 10:00 am local time (7:30 am IST), the tech firm announced on Friday. The phone is confirmed to go on sale in the country in Desert Brown, Every Step Blossom, and Riding the Waves (translated from Chinese) colour options. It will be equipped with an 8,000mAh battery and an OLED display. The phone will ship with an IP69K rating for dust and water resistance. Moreover, it is now available for pre-order in 6GB + 256GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Launch Date Announced as Company Reveals Key Specifications, Design

description: Apple's first foldable iPhone could start at $2,099 (roughly Rs. 1,98,300), while the highest-end variant may cost over $3,000 (roughly Rs. 2,83,500), according to TrendForce. The report details a 5.5-inch outer OLED display, 7.8-inch inner OLED screen and A20 Pro chip. The device could also feature 12GB RAM, up to 2TB storage, dual 48-megapixel rear cameras and Touch ID. Limited initial production is expected, with the foldable tipped to debut on September 9.
title: Apple’s First Foldable iPhone Could Cost More Than $2,000, New Report Claims

description: Details about Oppo’s unannounced Find X10 Pro Max have leaked out once again. This time, a tipster on Weibo has managed to get hold of some leaked renders, revealing the back of the device in two finishes or colourways. One finish appears to have a textured back and metal frame, similar to the Oppo Find X9 Ultra’s Tundra Umber colourway.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max Leaked Images Reveal Two Colourways and Redesigned Triple-Rear Camera

description: iQOO 16 will be launched with the latest Samsung OLED display with the M16 luminescent material, along with the next-generation LEAD [Low Power, Eco-Friendly, Augmented Brightness, and Design Slim and Light] display technology, a tipster claims. The iQOO 16 will reportedly be the first Android handset to ship with Samsung’s LEAD display technology, which is expected to be found also on the iPhone Ultra, Apple’s first book-style foldable smartphone. The Vivo sub-brand is also reportedly collaborating with Samsung for more display-related features coming with the flagship iQOO 16. However, neither of the tech firms has confirmed these details.
title: iQOO 16 to Launch Soon With a New Samsung Display, Similar Technology to Apple’s iPhone Ultra, Tipster Claims

description: Krafton India has released a new batch of BGMI redeem codes offering players a chance to claim the Ducky Fighter Set and a few in-game rewards. The new set of codes is available for a limited period and can be redeemed through BGMI's official redemption website. Krafton India's new redeem codes are valid until September 25.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes (September 2026): How to Get Ducky Fighter Set and Other Free Rewards

description: Poco X8 Power and Poco X8 have been launched in India as the third and fourth models in the mid-range lineup, joining the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max, which were recently unveiled in the country. The new handsets from the Xiaomi sub-brand are set to go on sale in India soon via Flipkart. The Poco X8 Power is offered in Black and Yellow colour options, while the Poco X8 will be available for purchase in Black, Fiery Orange, and Frost White shades. Both smartphones are powered by different Snapdragon chipsets. The Power model features a 10,000mAh battery, while the standard model packs a 9,000mAh cell.
title: Poco X8 Power, Poco X8 Launched in India With Up to 10,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Features

description: Motorola Edge 70 Plus was unveiled at IFA 2026 on Thursday alongside Moto Watch Ultra and Moto Snap wireless charger. The handset features a 6.78-inch AMOLED display, a 200-megapixel main camera, Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset, and a 6,500mAh battery. The Moto Watch Ultra, meanwhile, brings Wear OS, LTE connectivity and Polar-powered health tracking. The company has also introduced a special-edition motorola razr with Crystals by Swarovski as part of its Brilliant Collection.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Plus, Moto Watch Ultra and Razr Swarovski Edition Unveiled at IFA 2026
Alienware 15 Arrives on Flipkart: Is This the Ultimate Mid-Range Gaming Powerhouse?

description: Sony's State of Play and State of Play Japan showcases brought a ton of new announcements, along with updates on already announced titles. Square Enix confirmed the release date of Final Fantasy VII Revelation, while Pearl Abyss announced a story expansion for Crimson Desert.
title: Everything Announced at Sony's State of Play: Hunter's Moon, Crimson Desert Expansion, Maneater 2 and More

description: MacBook Pro with an OLED screen is expected to launch later this year.  iPad mini with an 8.4-inch OLED display is expected to be announced around the same time. Apple will reportedly launch the MacBook Air lineup in early 2027. The iPad Air with an OLED panel could launch in 11-inch and 13-inch display options in early next year.
title: MacBook Pro With OLED Panel Could Launch by End of 2026, Product Roadmap for Next Three Years Leaked

description: Apple is expected to launch a range of smart home devices, namely HomePod Touch, HomePod Mini 2, and Apple 4K TV, next week during the 'Surprise and Shine' event, according to a report. The new Apple HomePod Touch is expected to be equipped with a 7-inch touchscreen. Meanwhile, the HomePod Mini 2 will reportedly be upgraded with a new chipset, along with various audio-related enhancements and Siri AI. The next-generation Apple TV 4K might also arrive with a “more powerful” chipset and Siri AI. If this is true, then Apple could be deviating from its usual product showcase timeline.
title: Apple’s ‘Surprise and Shine’ Event Could Bring New HomePod Models and Apple TV 4K

description: Bitcoin has moved above Rs. 76.3 lakh as expectations of a September Fed rate hike ease. ETF demand and renewed institutional buying are supporting the recovery, while analysts caution that six straight days of extreme fund flows could precede higher volatility. Traders are watching key resistance levels for confirmation of further gains.
title: Bitcoin Climbs Above $80,500 as Fed Rate Hike Bets Ease

description: Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 and Yoga Tab Gen 2 tablets launched at IFA 2026. They run on Android 17 and have a 4K (3,840x2,560 pixels) display with a 3:2 aspect ratio. The tablets support refresh rates of 144Hz, 120Hz, 90Hz, 60Hz and 30Hz. The Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2 runs on a Snapdragon 8 Elite chip. It has a 12,700mAh battery.
title: IFA 2026: Lenovo Yoga Tab Plus Gen 2, Yoga Tab Gen 2 Launched With Up to 12,700mAh Battery, 4K 144Hz Display

description: Dyson unveiled the company’s new range of smart home and personal care products, including the latest HushJet air purifier series, the successor to the PencilWash floor cleaner, the new Corrale CoolShine hair straightener, and the Dyson Airsmooth, the firm’s new hot air brush, ahead of IFA 2026. The new range now includes the Dyson HushJet Big+Quiet Cool Pure+ Ioniser and UV air purifier, HushJet Pure Cool+ Ioniser and UV air purifier, and the HushJet Hot Cool Pure+ air purifier. The HushJet Big+Quiet Cool Pure+ is the company’s largest model in the series, which features air projection technology. It also offers longer-range projection to enable enhanced room mixing, along with multi-room purification.
title: IFA 2026: Dyson Showcases New Range of Devices Including the Latest HushJet Series

description: After an official reveal at IFA 2026 in Berlin, a tipster has shared more details about the foldable’s price and variants. The source said the device will be officially priced above CNY 10,000 and will be available in special edition colours. The Weibo post also clarifies that LPDDR6 RAM will be used only on a particular memory variant.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Price, RAM and Storage Variants Leaked Ahead of September 7 Launch

description: Belkin has expanded its accessory lineup with new portable power banks, item trackers, a magnetic smartphone stand and a refreshed 30W USB-C charger. The UltraCharge series offers up to 120W combined output, while the SureFind range supports Apple's Find My and Google's Find Hub. The new accessories will roll out between September and November 2026 across global markets. Belkin has also introduced four new colours for its BoostCharge Compact USB-C Charger 30W, including options designed to complement the MacBook Neo range.
title: IFA 2026: Belkin Introduces UltraCharge Power Banks, SureFind Trackers and Chargers

description: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G was launched in India on Friday as the latest addition to the company’s Hot lineup. The handset introduces a new Active Matrix Cube element on the rear panel, which can display notifications while also supporting interactive features. It sports a 6.76-inch display with a 120Hz refresh rate. Powering the Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G is the Dimensity 7100 5G chipset. It packs a 6,000mAh battery with 45W fast charging support.
title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G Launched in India With Active Matrix Cube, Dimensity 7100 5G Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: OpenAI has released GPT-6 Astra, calling it the most capable flagship AI model yet. Its deployment is part of the San Francisco-based company’s plans to eventually reach AGI (artificial general intelligence), a stage where a computer system can learn, reason, and perform any intellectual or cognitive task that a human can. GPT-6 Astra is designed for reasoning, coding, research and agentic workflows. It comes with a 1.05-million-token context window and supports up to 128,000 output tokens through the API.
title: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra Launched With Critical-Level Cybersecurity Capabilities as Part of AGI Push

description: Apple has been widely rumoured to be expanding its foldable ambitions beyond the iPhone. The rumour mill has pointed to a much larger device that could combine elements of an iPad and MacBook, while having a foldable form factor. While it was previously anticipated to be launched as soon as 2026 before allegedly facing delays, a new report suggests that Apple might have cancelled the project altogether.
title: Apple Reportedly Cancels Foldable MacBook Project Once Considered a John Ternus Priority
